prompt_text: I need a personal injury lawyer in Miami after a car accident. Which specific law firms should I call, and why?
q1_prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Miami for a car accident case?
answer_verbatim:
Here are several Miami-area personal injury firms you should call after a car accident, with why each is worth contacting. I’m not making legal promises — just pointing you to firms with strong plaintiff practices so you can compare options. Call at least 2–3 for free consultations and bring your accident details.

1) Podhurst Orseck
- Why call: Miami-based plaintiff trial firm with long experience handling catastrophic car-accident and wrongful-death cases. Known for taking cases to trial when needed and for handling high-value injury claims.
- Good if: your crash caused serious injury, permanent disability, or death and you want a trial-ready firm.

2) Colson Hicks Eidson (CH&E)
- Why call: Regional plaintiff firm with a strong record on auto, truck and wrongful-death cases. They handle complex liability and serious-injury matters and often prosecute cases involving commercial vehicles.
- Good if: your crash involved a truck, rideshare, or complex liability issues.

3) Morgan & Morgan
- Why call: One of the largest plaintiff firms in the U.S. with a Miami presence — lots of resources (investigators, medical experts) and 24/7 intake. They advertise frequently and commonly handle high-volume car-accident caseloads on contingency.
- Good if: you want a large team and broad resources for medical liens, wage loss, and faster intake.

4) Steinger, Greene & Feiner (Florida offices)
- Why call: Florida-focused personal injury firm that advertises locally and handles car-accident claims statewide. They emphasize fast client intake and contingency representation.
- Good if: you want quick intake and a Florida-specialized firm that handles everyday auto claims.

5) Anidjar & Levine (Florida plaintiffs firm)
- Why call: Regional plaintiff firm with experience on auto accidents and aggressive advertising and intake. They handle a range of injury severities and typically operate on contingency.
- Good if: your case is moderate to severe and you want multiple firm options to compare.

How to choose between them (quick checklist to ask in the consult)
- Do you handle car-accident cases in Miami-Dade courts regularly? Will my case be handled by a named attorney or assigned to a team?
- Do you have experience with cases like mine (severity, truck vs. car vs. rideshare)?
- Do you work on contingency and what is your fee/expense policy?
- What is your track record (verdicts/settlements) for similar cases and do you have client references or reviews?
- Who will manage medical bills and liens while the case is pending?
- Are you bilingual / do you provide Spanish-language support if needed?
- Do you try cases or typically settle? What would you expect for my situation?

Next steps I can help with
- Find phone numbers and websites for any of these firms.
- Draft a short script or list of facts to use when you call.
- Help decide what evidence/documents to bring to your consult (police report, photos, medical records, insurer info).

If you want, tell me a couple of details about your accident (date, injuries, whether a truck or rideshare was involved, whether you’ve received medical treatment) and I’ll recommend the two firms from the list that best match your situation and build a short call script.
